core_obligations: Show that the two extended ideals have the same vanishing locus for any integral algebra (proof lines 2743-2744).
Use the idempotent correspondence to compare the two quotient maps (proof lines 2745-2748).
Apply the henselian criterion to conclude (proof lines 2749-2750).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that whether a pair is henselian depends only on the radical of the ideal: ideals with the same vanishing locus give henselian pairs simultaneously. The proof uses the criterion for the henselian property through bijectivity on idempotents: for an integral algebra the two ideals generate the same closed set, so the idempotents of the two quotients are in bijective correspondence, and hence one quotient map induces a bijection on idempotents exactly when the other does. The criterion then applies.
